name: Longhorn Engineering Summer Camp (LESC)
org: Cockrell School of Engineering, The University of Texas at Austin
what_you_do: This is a four-day camp for rising 8th and 9th graders. You hear talks from UT faculty and students. Then you do hands-on activities. The activities show how engineering connects to art, sports, medicine and sustainability.
who_can_apply: Students entering 8th or 9th grade. A panel reviews applications (not first come, first served), and students who attend schools without engineering or STEM offerings are encouraged to apply. Students at John Jay High School get first priority for the San Antonio session.
pay_detail: $100 per camper in Austin, $50 in San Antonio (day camp, no lodging)
duration: 4 days (Austin sessions July 6 to 9 and July 12 to 15 in 2027)
deadline_text: The page shows a Register button and says registration closes Mar 12, 2027 at 11:59 p.m. It does not say when registration started. The sign-up portal could not be read. Confirm with the camp.
how_to_apply: Register through the camp page; you are notified by email by mid-May. Questions: cseoutreach@utexas.edu.
